blueprint.title: Gas-Generator Liquid Rocket Engine
blueprint.summary: A sea-level regeneratively cooled engine with a Rao bell nozzle, offset turbopump, gas generator, and smooth feed lines. The gimbal mount carries thrust through a strut frame to the injector dome.

parts.name: Gimbal mount
parts.role: Ball joint carrying engine thrust into the vehicle
parts.shape: Sphere with a top cylindrical socket and two lower lug bores; centerline on engine axis
parts.size: sphere diameter 180 mm; socket height 80 mm; lug width 140 mm

parts.name: Thrust frame
parts.role: Transfers gimbal loads to the injector dome
parts.shape: Four tapered box struts arrayed 90 degrees apart, from gimbal lugs to a ring at the injector; boolean-joined to a top hub and lower collar
parts.size: height 250 mm; strut section 45 by 35 mm; lower ring radius 170 mm

parts.name: Injector dome
parts.role: Caps the chamber and distributes propellants to the injector face
parts.shape: Revolved hemispherical dome over a short cylindrical flange; flat bottom face with a radial array of 180 small orifice bosses
parts.size: dome diameter 360 mm; flange height 35 mm; orifice boss diameter 8 mm

parts.name: Thrust chamber and bell nozzle
parts.role: Regeneratively cooled combustion chamber, throat, and expanding bell
parts.shape: Use nozzle op with throat_radius 120, expansion_ratio 18, contraction_ratio 2.5; subtract an inner revolved cavity to leave a 6 mm wall, then add a thin outer jacket from throat to exit
parts.size: throat radius 120 mm; chamber radius 190 mm; exit radius 509 mm; chamber length 400 mm; bell length 1100 mm
parts.position: exit plane y=0; throat at y=1100; chamber top at y=1500

parts.name: Coolant manifold
parts.role: Distributes fuel around the wall at the end of the regenerative section
parts.shape: Torus ring with 24 radial inlet ports and two tangent feed-line bosses
parts.size: major radius 170 mm; minor radius 28 mm; port diameter 18 mm

parts.name: Turbopump bracket
parts.role: Mounts the turbopump shaft and gas generator beside the chamber
parts.shape: Box plate with a central shaft bore, two bearing bosses, and a gas-generator flange; attached to the chamber wall by three bolt bosses
parts.size: plate 220 by 220 by 40 mm; shaft bore diameter 52 mm
parts.position: center at [360, 1380, 0], plate normal along X

parts.name: Turbopump shaft
parts.role: Carries turbine, fuel pump, and oxidizer pump on one axis
parts.shape: Cylinder with stepped journal diameters and keyways; supported in bracket bearing bosses
parts.size: length 450 mm; main diameter 48 mm; end diameter 36 mm
parts.position: axis at [360, 0, 0], from y=1150 to y=1600

parts.name: Turbine rotor
parts.role: Expands gas-generator flow to drive the turbopump
parts.shape: Rotor op: hub with 18 twisted airfoil blades, axial inlet and radial outlet; keyed to shaft
parts.size: hub diameter 160 mm; blade tip diameter 300 mm; axial width 85 mm

parts.name: Fuel pump volute
parts.role: Raises fuel pressure to the injector and coolant manifold
parts.shape: Torus-shaped volute casing with a spiral internal passage, axial inlet along the shaft, and a tangent outlet boss
parts.size: volute major radius 120 mm; minor radius 48 mm; outlet diameter 90 mm

parts.name: Oxidizer pump volute
parts.role: Raises oxidizer pressure to the injector
parts.shape: Torus-shaped volute casing with a spiral internal passage, axial inlet along the shaft, and a tangent outlet boss
parts.size: volute major radius 120 mm; minor radius 48 mm; outlet diameter 90 mm

parts.name: Gas generator
parts.role: Burns a rich fuel mixture to produce turbine-driving gas
parts.shape: Small revolved chamber and bell: cylindrical chamber, conical contraction, short bell; injector boss on top and exhaust nozzle at the side
parts.size: chamber diameter 110 mm; length 120 mm; exit diameter 170 mm

parts.name: Gas-generator exhaust duct
parts.role: Routes turbine exhaust away from the main bell
parts.shape: Bent tube with smooth 90-degree radius, from gas-generator exit to a side exhaust nozzle
parts.size: tube diameter 70 mm; bend radius 120 mm; length 260 mm

parts.name: Fuel feed line
parts.role: Delivers fuel from pump to injector and coolant manifold
parts.shape: Smooth tube op with a tee: one branch to injector dome, one branch to coolant manifold; all bends radius at least 150 mm
parts.size: tube diameter 80 mm; total developed length 720 mm
parts.position: from fuel pump outlet [480, 1460, 0] to injector [0, 1580, 0] and manifold [0, 1100, 0]

parts.name: Oxidizer feed line
parts.role: Delivers oxidizer from pump to injector dome
parts.shape: Smooth tube op with a single 90-degree bend and flanged ends
parts.size: tube diameter 80 mm; length 520 mm; bend radius 140 mm
parts.position: from oxidizer pump outlet [480, 1565, 0] to injector [0, 1600, 0]

parts.name: Main feed valves
parts.role: Isolate the main propellant lines near the injector
parts.shape: Cylindrical valve body with a rectangular actuator block and two flanged line bosses
parts.size: body diameter 130 mm; length 150 mm; actuator 90 by 70 by 60 mm
parts.position: oxidizer valve at [150, 1600, 0]; fuel valve at [150, 1520, 0]

parts.name: Gimbal actuators
parts.role: Hydraulic cylinders that swing the engine about the gimbal
parts.shape: Telescoping cylinder and rod with clevis ends; two units 90 degrees apart, from thrust frame to chamber jacket
parts.size: bore diameter 70 mm; stroke length 220 mm; rod diameter 32 mm

callouts: Engine axis is vertical on Y; nozzle exit at y=0, injector at y=1500.
Nozzle: throat radius 120 mm, expansion ratio 18, contraction ratio 2.5.
Chamber liner is copper; outer jacket and bell are brushed steel.
Turbopump shaft is offset 360 mm from the engine axis and parallel to Y.
Gas-generator exhaust is vented beside the main bell, not into the nozzle.
Feed lines use smooth bends; no sharp elbows on propellant paths.
